headline_item.title_zh: DeepMind聘任哲学家以应对AGI意识挑战
headline_item.title_en: Google DeepMind’s Henry Shevlin: ‘This is the most important part of being human’
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 剑桥大学学者Henry Shevlin加入Google DeepMind，负责研究AI意识、人机关系及通用人工智能就绪性
headline_item.event_summary_en: Henry Shevlin, former associate director at the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence, has joined Google DeepMind as an in-house philosopher. He is tasked with researching machine consciousness, human-AI ethics, and AGI readiness to address growing public and academic concerns regarding existential risks and AI autonomy.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Henry Shevlin（Google DeepMind哲学家、前剑桥大学学者）在Google DeepMind内部研究团队：负责机器意识、人机交互伦理及AGI发展准备度评估
【起因与机理】针对AI领域日益增长的安全性担忧及对AI意识觉醒的理论探索需求
【核心事实细节】Google DeepMind扩容伦理研究团队以应对AGI发展中的认知科学风险。
【核心诉求与态度】大型科技公司正通过制度化引入跨学科专家来回应AI安全性与生存威胁争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Henry Shevlin (Google DeepMind Philosopher): Leading research on machine consciousness and AGI social readiness
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing intensifying safety concerns and the philosophical implications of AI development
[Key Fact Detail] Google DeepMind expands ethics research to address AGI-related cognitive risks.
[Key Position & Outlook] Tech firms are institutionalizing interdisciplinary oversight to manage AI safety concerns.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 头部大模型厂商通过高薪吸纳哲学与伦理学者，本质上是将社会契约与安全性验证前置于技术路径中，以缓解监管压力。此举反映了AI研发重心已从单纯的性能指标迭代，转向对认知边界与主体性风险的防御性治理，试图在AGI爆发前建立“合规护栏”的知识体系。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: By integrating philosophers into core research teams, tech giants are proactively internalizing ethical compliance to mitigate regulatory scrutiny. This shift signifies that AI development is moving beyond raw performance scaling toward establishing robust conceptual frameworks for AI safety and autonomy governance.

headlines.title_zh: 黎曼猜想证明引发AI与人类数学家角力
headlines.title_en: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge声称利用Claude证明了黎曼猜想，随后Stanford学者发布人类独立证明草案
headlines.event_summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced a proof for the Riemann Hypothesis using the Claude model, utilizing simulated derivatives. Shortly after, Stanford math professor and AMS president Ravi Vakil released an independent, human-only draft proof by Alessandro Masullo, emphasizing the exclusion of AI assistance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Levent Alpöge (Anthropic)、Alessandro Masullo (斯坦福大学研究员)、Ravi Vakil (美国数学会主席)：Alpöge通过AI辅助提出证明方案；斯坦福团队发布纯人工验证草案
【起因与机理】AI在高端数论推演中的介入引发了学界关于“AI辅助证明”有效性与学术主权的竞逐
【核心事实细节】数学界核心课题黎曼猜想成为AI证明效力的“压力测试”场景。
【各方立场与态度】学术界以纯人工草案对冲AI产出，凸显数学证明中的伦理与权属争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Levent Alpöge (Anthropic), Alessandro Masullo (Stanford), Ravi Vakil (AMS President): Alpöge presented an AI-assisted proof; Stanford released a purely human-authored competing draft
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising tension over the validity and attribution of AI-assisted mathematical proofs
[Key Fact Detail] The Riemann Hypothesis serves as a stress test for AI-assisted mathematical reasoning.
[Key Position & Outlook] Academia counter-positions human-authored work against AI output, intensifying attribution debates.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 黎曼猜想证明权的争夺战本质是AI原生科学发现与传统学术范式的权责碰撞。人类学者通过“抢发”纯人工草案重申数学研究的解释权与可追溯性，这凸显了在基础科学高地，由于AI幻觉风险与“黑箱”逻辑，学界对大模型输出结果的信任度依然处于极低水平。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The competing claims on the Riemann Hypothesis highlight a friction between AI-native scientific discovery and traditional academic paradigms. The rapid release of a human-only proof underscores the academic community's deep skepticism toward AI-assisted results, driven by concerns over hallucination and the 'black box' nature of LLM reasoning.

headlines.title_zh: 新型开放模型 Inkling 2 Mini 可以循环思考，用更少的单词解决问题，并且仍然可以在笔记本电脑上运行
headlines.title_en: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
headlines.event_summary_zh: Thinking Machines推出支持本地运行的循环Transformer模型Inkling 2 Mini，通过内部层循环推理优化计算效率与逻辑性能
headlines.event_summary_en: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, which utilizes a looped transformer architecture where 12 of its 24 layers execute three times to enhance reasoning without increasing token generation. The MoE model features 26.4 billion total parameters with 5.4 billion active per token, supports a 1-million-token context window, and is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】思维机器在AI开源社区与大模型部署环境：发布Inkling 2 Mini模型，具备循环推理架构与百万级上下文窗口
【起因与机理】旨在通过架构级优化在保持低部署成本的同时，提升小规模参数模型在代理编码任务中的表现
【关键数据与实测】264亿总参数量，推理时仅激活54亿，支持100万上下文长度。
【各方立场与态度】在DeepSWE v1.1及Vals Index v2.2编码评测中领先同量级开源模型。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thinking Machines: Released Inkling 2 Mini featuring looped inference and 1M token context
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To optimize compute efficiency and reasoning capabilities for small-parameter models in agentic coding tasks
[Key Metrics] 26.4B total parameters, 5.4B active, with 1M token context window.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outperforms comparable open-source models on DeepSWE v1.1 and Vals Index v2.2 coding benchmarks.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 循环Transformer通过时间维度的计算复用，打破了参数规模与推理性能的线性关联，为边缘侧模型提供了新的Scaling Law优化路径。此举在商业上大幅降低了高复杂逻辑任务的Token开销，对于需要频繁进行长程规划的Agentic Workflow具有极高的部署性价比。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The looped transformer architecture decouples parameter count from reasoning performance via temporal compute reuse, offering a new scaling trajectory for edge models. This approach significantly reduces the cost-per-reasoning-step for agentic workflows, providing a strong competitive edge for local deployment scenarios.

titans.name: Yann LeCun
titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
